name.fr-FR: Correspondance de saint Vincent de Paul, tome VIII
name.en-US: Correspondence of St. Vincent de Paul, vol. VIII
name.pt-BR: Correspondência de São Vicente de Paulo, tomo VIII

description.fr-FR: Les lettres 2888 à 3316 de la Correspondance de saint Vincent, tome VIII de l’édition de Pierre Coste (1659-1661), une lettre par chapitre, groupées par année, avec les lettres adressées à Vincent que Coste y a intercalées, ses notices de sources et ses notes.
description.en-US: Letters 2888 to 3316 of St. Vincent’s Correspondence, vol. VIII of Pierre Coste’s edition (1659-1661), one letter per chapter and grouped by year, with the letters addressed to Vincent that Coste interleaves, his source notices and notes.
description.pt-BR: As cartas 2888 a 3316 da Correspondência de São Vicente, tomo VIII da edição de Pierre Coste (1659-1661).

sources.edition: Saint Vincent de Paul, Correspondance, entretiens, documents, éd. Pierre Coste C.M., Paris: Gabalda, 1920-1925, tome VIII; digital edition by P. Claude Lautissier C.M. and the Daughters of Charity (1992), on JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: All letters of the tome, one per chapter, including the letters to Vincent that Coste prints among them, with Coste’s source notices and footnotes kept as notes. Coste’s introduction is not included; letters whose heading the transcription lost stay inside the preceding chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Vincent died in 1660; Coste’s edition appeared in 1920-25 and Coste died in 1935. The digital transcription is of the same text, with Coste’s notes.
